calculations.text: revenue: 1248 vs 1058 (Q1 FY27 vs Q1 FY26) = +18.0% YoY
ebitda_margin: 12.9% -> 11.2% (Q1 FY27 vs Q1 FY26) = -170 bps
Pledged shares as % of TOTAL shares (as of 30 Jun 2026) = 4.1% x 58.2% = 2.4% (the 4.1% is a share of promoter holding only)
Capex: 70% of 620 crore spent = 434 crore; remaining = 186 crore
Tip-sheet target 1450 vs last reported price 1012 implies +43% (the tip sheet itself claims 60%; prices are from different dates)
GST demand 46.3 crore = 56% of Q1 FY27 profit after tax (82 crore); demand covers earlier years, profit is one quarter: sizes the exposure only
Data check: none of the 7 relevant documents has a valuation multiple or market cap; a cash-flow statement; an absolute debt or cash figure; full-year results; a dividend or buyback
